title: Keep header sync labels readable at enlarged phone text
description: At 360 pixels and 200-percent text, full-shell light/dark snapshots reduce the header sync label to Sy while the Refresh button remains large. The status word cannot be read from the visible chip.
expected_behavior: Expose an understandable complete sync-state label or concise summary at enlarged phone text, retain full time/detail on demand, and preserve menu and Refresh access.
context: Separate from the required header/main clearance correction. Current screenshots observe truncation of the synced label; failure/stale/loading variants need researched coverage. Existing navigation compaction and dashboard freshness tasks do not directly specify header-label legibility.
